subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – confirmation email and currency
body_text:
Hi Tara,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted your webinar registration page to send the confirmation email and your products page to show the right currency. Here is a quick summary so you have everything in one place.

What we resolved:
- We turned on the confirmation email for your webinar registration page and saved it, and the confirmation email from your test registration arrived.
- Following our guidance, you selected Indian Rupee in your account's regional settings and saved it, and your products page now shows rupees.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-12

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
